description: matches follows written-terminator priority as begins does. On A B T, r could leave out [T] and read the token as its last T, but the prefix before c can read c and then T as the optional. So the omission is forbidden, and matches of r over the whole text is false (engine §4).
grammar:
%rule text A B T
%conditions matches($, r)
%rule r A c [+T] T
%rule c B
